title: Add a customer
text: A customer record holds contact details, ID numbers, and a Type. The Type decides which discount the cashier gives.
steps: Click Sidebar > Customers.
Click Add Customer.
Enter the customer's name and contact details.
Choose a Customer Type, such as Regular, Senior Citizen, PWD, or Solo Parent.
Add a Loyalty Card No. if the customer should earn points or hold load.
Click Save.

title: Import customers or edit many at once
text: Bulk Manage shows the list as a spreadsheet. Add rows, fix cells, or bring in a CSV or Excel file, then save once.
steps: Click Sidebar > Customers.
Click Bulk Manage > Select a Branch. Use a computer with a wide screen.
Edit the cells, or click Import and choose a CSV or Excel file.
Imported rows match existing customers, so duplicates are not added.
Or Click add from Masterlist,then Select a customer from the other branch to copy them to this branch.
Click Save.

title: See a customer's purchases and what they owe
text: Details shows total spent, Receivables, and every receipt. Credit receipts show their due date.
steps: Click Sidebar > Customers.
Click the arrow at the end of the customer row, then click Details.
Receivables shows the amount the customer still owes.
Click the invoice to see its items and payment status.
To collect payment, open Point of Sale > More Options > Unpaid ,then Select the customer.

title: Top up load, redeem points, or view loyalty history
text: Manage Loyalty shows for any customer with a loyalty card number. It holds their load, points, and history.
steps: Click Sidebar > Customers.
Click the arrow at the end of the row, then click Manage Loyalty.
Click Top-Up Balance to add or remove load.
Click Redeem Points to exchange points for load.
Click View History to see all load and point activity.

title: Send a customer their virtual loyalty card
text: The loyalty card can be downloaded or emailed to the customer. The design is set per branch in Settings.
steps: Click Sidebar > Customers.
Click the arrow at the end of the row, then click Manage Loyalty.
Use the card buttons to download or email the card.
To change the design, click Settings > Loyalty Points > Loyalty Card Design.

title: Set how points are earned and redeemed
text: Loyalty Points settings decide how much a customer must spend to earn points, and what points are worth.
steps: Click Settings > Loyalty Points.
Set Minimum Purchase and Points Earned to control how customers earn points.
Set Points Required and Redeemable Amount to control how customers redeem points.
Click Save.

title: Remove a customer from a branch
text: Customers are shared across branches. Delete removes them from the branch you are on, not from every branch.
steps: Click Sidebar > Customers.
Click the arrow at the end of the row, then click Delete.
Confirm the deletion. The built-in walk-in customer cannot be deleted.

title: Load and top-up reports
text: Print & Export holds the customer list plus two load reports: Unearned Revenue and Total Top-Up Amount.
steps: Click Sidebar > Customers.
Click Print & Export in the top bar.
Unearned Revenue shows the load customers still hold. Total Top-Up Amount shows their total load for a period.
Choose Print, PDF, or Excel to export the customer list on screen.
